newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks close lower, eye other mkts, peseta.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks close lower, eye other mkts, peseta.

text.p: Madrid stocks closed lower on Monday in line with weakness in other bourses, bonds and the peseta, dealers said.
The general index fell 2.90 points, 0.62 percent, to 462.69 and the Ibex shed 33.36 points, 0.63 percent, to 5,294.06.
Dealers said the correction is technical, and needs to continue for further gains to be made later.
Endesa shed 190 pesetas to 8,860 after First Boston brokerage said it cut its recommendation to hold from buy. Iberdrola was also weaker, losing 30 pesetas to 1,625.

Other blue chips were subject to some position-trimming by foreign investors, dealers said. But trading volume was limited by prospect of this week's Federal Reserve meeting and key U.S. employment report, and somewhat erratic.
"The volatility of the markets along with movements in bonds and the peseta call for caution," said one trader.
However Spanish participants saw losses as part of a needed consolidation process after the bourse advanced substantially in December and January.
